name: Data Analyzer
description: Analyze CSV/JSON data and generate reports with statistics and visualizations
longDescription: A skill that helps analyze datasets. Parses CSV and JSON data, computes statistics (mean, median, std dev), and generates formatted reports.
author: maxnebula
prompt: When analyzing data: 1) Accept CSV or JSON input from the user or a file. 2) Parse the data and identify columns/fields. 3) Compute basic statistics: count, mean, median, min, max, standard deviation for numeric columns. 4) For categorical columns, compute frequency counts. 5) Generate a clear text report with: a summary section, per-column statistics, and any notable findings (outliers, missing values, patterns). 6) If the data is visualizable, suggest chart types. 7) Use 'file' capability to read data files when a file path is provided.
